en: A black‑and‑white postcard showing a large, three‑story neoclassical public building with simple ornamentation and tall rectangular windows. The structure stands behind a low fence and a row of small conifer trees, with a broad lawn or square in front. Flagpoles rise in the open area, and leafy trees line a sidewalk along the right edge of the image. The scene appears calm and slightly formal, suggesting a civic or institutional building in a European town. A handwritten number "45-27" is visible at the top center of the postcard.
